newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cypriot soldier injured by another in shooting.
newsitem.headline: Cypriot soldier injured by another in shooting.

text.p: A Greek Cypriot soldier was shot in the stomach by a fellow soldier in Cyprus on Tuesday after a row, military officials said.
"The reason was childish," said a defence source, who did not give details. The source said the soldier who apparently fired the shot was detained. The wounded soldier is in hospital.
The shooting occured at 1:00 p.m. (1000 GMT) at a sentry post southeast of capital Nicosia and near the ceasefire line dividing the island.
Cyprus has been divided into Turkish and Greek areas since a Turkish invasion in 1974 in the wake of a short-lived coup engineered by the military regime ruling Greece at the time.
